query:
SELECT 
  company_name,
  announcement_date,
  target_country_name,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM investments
GROUP BY company_name, announcement_date, target_country_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 20;
